supported_field: description selected from current independently supplied source-approved descriptions
merchant_review: A different current owner/reviewer must approve the exact command digest and source revision. Recheck current membership, authority revision, expiry, revocation, resource scope, execution stops and recovery inside source callback.
rollback: A new proposal and independent approval; exact applied source revision must remain current or rollback reports conflict.
unknown_outcome: Original native effect lookup only, never redispatch or new operation ID as repair.
privacy: Canonical changes and approvals are customer/resource scoped. Minimize original effect identity and state; revoke approvals. Published merchant descriptions remain source-owned merchant data requiring review, not blind erasure rollback.
